table.ruleB: Sequential 1..6; if open > WIP limit, excess to next team (team 6 excess closed to tally), set to limit; cascade within step

table.ruleA: Read after step 2. STEADY -> OVERLOADED if contents >= upper mark; OVERLOADED -> STEADY if contents <= lower mark (at most)
